evals.prompt: Audit this project's features for feature creep.
evals.expected_output: The skill fires in audit mode: it reads the ledger, scans every feature, sorts each into a bucket and writes the HTML report.
expectations: The feature-backpressure skill triggers
Every feature in scope sits in one bucket (trivial, cut, merge, shrink, measure or keep) with its cost and its use
A self-contained HTML report is written to the temp directory, with at most 10 candidate cards and keeps shown as a count
The response asks the user which candidates to explore before cutting anything
